description: NaSbF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.44 Å. Sb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.60 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Sb atom.
